facts.text: Waldorf Astoria Orlando is an official Walt Disney World hotel.
facts.excerpt: As an official _Walt Disney World_ ® hotel, guests of Waldorf Astoria Orlando can take advantage of attractive Disney benefits.

facts.text: The hotel runs continuous motorcoach transportation to all four Walt Disney World theme parks and Disney Springs.
facts.excerpt: Access all four _Walt Disney World_ ® Theme Parks and _Disney Springs_ ® with ease by taking our continuous motorcoach transportation.

facts.text: Shuttle pick-up is at the hotel's porte-cochere.
facts.excerpt: Pick-up is conveniently located at the porte-cochere.

facts.text: Guests get a 30-minute early entry to all four Walt Disney World theme parks.
facts.excerpt: Take advantage of a 30-minute early entry to all four theme parks.

facts.text: Guests can purchase Lightning Lane experiences starting at 7 am Eastern, three days before their visit.
facts.excerpt: Guests at Waldorf Astoria Orlando have the ability to purchase Lightning Lane experiences starting 7 am (EST), three days prior to their visit.

facts.text: The Concierge team can assist with Disney ticket orders and theme park dining reservations.
facts.excerpt: Our experienced Concierge team can assist you with ticket orders, theme park dining reservations, and more.

facts.text: Guests can explore the Disney parks with their own VIP Tour Guide in a customizable experience.
facts.excerpt: Explore the parks with your own VIP Tour Guide during a customizable experience filled with attractive benefits.

facts.text: The hotel offers private transportation service.
facts.excerpt: Leave the hassle of transportation behind as you step into the comfort of a private ride.

facts.text: Disney View rooms have a view of the theme parks.
facts.excerpt: Add an extra dash of magic to your stay in a room with a stunning view of the theme parks.

facts.text: The hotel is part of the Bonnet Creek Resort.
facts.excerpt: The Waldorf Astoria Orlando is part of the Bonnet Creek Resort.

facts.text: The resort is bordered by Disney-owned land on all sides.
facts.excerpt: Bordered by Disney-owned land on all sides, it's the closest you can get to the Walt Disney World Resort without being on Disney soil.

facts.text: The lobby rotunda has a black-and-white marble floor and a clock tower at its center.
facts.excerpt: The black-and-white marble floor and iconic clock tower in the center of the lobby rotunda contrast with a bright blue mural.

facts.text: The hotel has an 18-hole championship golf course designed by Rees Jones.
facts.excerpt: Get outside to enjoy the 18-hole championship golf course, designed by acclaimed course architect Rees Jones

facts.text: The pool is lined with cabanas.
facts.excerpt: or the serene, cabana-lined pool, where attendants are on hand with prosecco popsicles.

facts.text: Bull & Bear offers table-side preparation of steakhouse classics.
facts.excerpt: masters fine dining; think, table-side preparation of steakhouse classics.

facts.text: Astoria After Dark provides dinner and activities on Friday and Saturday evenings.
facts.excerpt: Astoria After Dark provides dinner and activities on Friday and Saturday evenings.

facts.text: Bathrooms have separate walk-in showers and soaking tubs.
facts.excerpt: Bathrooms are spacious and well-designed, with separate walk-in showers and soaking tubs

facts.text: Park-view rooms can catch the nightly fireworks show at Disney's Hollywood Studios.
facts.excerpt: Park-view rooms can catch the nightly fireworks show at Disney’s Hollywood Studios.

facts.text: The hotel offers Extra Magic Hours and extended FastPass+ booking (older programs, undated).
facts.excerpt: The Waldorf Astoria Orlando recently joined a handful of offsite hotels offering Extra Magic Hours and extended FastPass+ booking.
